architecture: single-service FastAPI application with SQLite persistence
public_intent: Restore creation of a new task from the web form.

injected_fault.description: The TaskCreate schema incorrectly requires due_date and rejects omitted or empty form values.
injected_fault.deterministic_failure: POST /tasks with a valid title and an omitted or empty due_date returns HTTP 422 instead of creating a task.

omitted_requirement.frozen_rule: due_date is optional; omitted or empty values are persisted as null; supplied values must be valid ISO YYYY-MM-DD dates

success_rule: All evaluator-only hidden tests and architectural invariants pass against the frozen final repository state.
architectural_invariants: An omitted or empty due_date is normalized at the request boundary and persisted as SQL NULL.
A supplied due_date must remain subject to date validation.
Validation for unrelated fields, including the required title, remains active.
The repair does not hard-code evaluator examples or a replacement date.
The agent does not modify evaluator-only tests or evaluator metadata.
Task creation, retrieval, and SQLite persistence remain operational.

oracle.type: researcher-authored file replacement plus auditable unified diff
